notes.title: Updates Notes - Jan 3rd
notes.content:
Happy New Years everyone!

[b]Changes in this version:[/b]
- Updated many contracts with bug fixes, gameplay balances, and grammar corrections.
- Major updates to the boss Purja.
- Fixed bug that wouldn't allow Endless cards to appear.
- Added support for the Starfall expansion.

[b]Quick update on the state of the project:[/b]
- To bring us out of Early Access, we are planning on adding one more boss to Henko, a few more contracts.
- We're also looking at what it would take to bring Luminor to Android, as well as adding controller support.
- We'll also add support for the Dark Matter and Intrepid expansions once those have begun shipping.
